verdict.rationale: An API that matches what users can do in the UI is a fair question for an authenticator or password-manager product, so the axis applies. However, 2FAS's own llms.txt declares 'Public API: None', and every probed OpenAPI path returns 404. The '2FAS API' mentioned in the docs (2fas-docs-22) is a service-provider integration for one-click 2FA enablement, not a user-facing API that mirrors UI functionality, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
